item.arcanum_storage.end_pouch.tooltip: A portable door to your ender chest. Right-click to open.
item.arcanum_storage.end_pouch.bound: Arcanum Binding: consumed on death to seal your armor, hotbar and offhand in an Archive Cache inside your ender chest.
item.arcanum_storage.archive_cache.lore: Sealed by the Arcanum Binding. It vanishes when emptied.
message.arcanum_storage.archive_cache.st: Your Arcanum Binding sealed your equipment in an Archive Cache inside your ender chest.
message.arcanum_storage.archive_cache.ov: Your Arcanum Binding sealed your equipment in an Archive Cache. Your ender chest was full, so the cache was placed in your inventory.
message.arcanum_storage.archive_cache.dr: Your Arcanum Binding sealed your equipment in an Archive Cache. There was no room, so it fell at your feet.
gui.arcanum_storage.sort_hint: Click to cycle: order, name, count
gui.arcanum_storage.sort.name: Name
gui.arcanum_storage.extraction_failed: That item is no longer available
gui.arcanum_storage.press.analyze_hint: Build a preview without moving any item
gui.arcanum_storage.press.organize_hint: Group matching items and free empty shulkers
gui.arcanum_storage.press.confirm_hint: Click Confirm to move the items.
gui.arcanum_storage.press.footer: Preview only: nothing moves until you confirm.
gui.arcanum_storage.press.no_free: No shulker will be freed (all are full)
gui.arcanum_storage.press.status.no_netw: No cable network. Connect the Archive Connector to an Archive Cable.
gui.arcanum_storage.press.status.no_ches: No chest in this cable network.
gui.arcanum_storage.press.status.multipl: This network has more than one chest. The press only works with a single chest (a double chest counts as one).
gui.arcanum_storage.press.status.no_shul: No unlabeled shulkers in this chest.
gui.arcanum_storage.press.status.ready: Preview ready. Check the summary and confirm.
gui.arcanum_storage.press.status.not_ana: Press Analyze to build the preview.
gui.arcanum_storage.press.status.changed: The chest changed. Nothing was moved.
gui.arcanum_storage.press.status.failed: The operation failed. Nothing was moved.
enchantment.arcanum_storage.arcanum_bind: On death, the pouch is consumed and seals your armor, hotbar and offhand in an Archive Cache inside your ender chest. The 27 backpack slots drop normally.
